edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Zethroll constructor.
execute is gated by fromBankroll which validates msg.sender against ValidBankrollAddress.
finishBet forwards msg.sender as the target of _finishBet.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before overwriting contractBalance.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before changing maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before changing minBet.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before pausing/unpausing the game.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before selfdestructing the contract.
_rollUnder parameter flows into the stored playerRoll.rollUnder.
_tkn struct (sender/value) flows into the playerRoll storage struct.
userDivRate parameter is stored as divRate and passed to betIsValid.
target address indexes playerRolls in _finishBet.
to recipient is forwarded into the external gameRequestTokens call.
tokens amount is forwarded into the external gameRequestTokens call.
_initBet is used in the profit multiplication/division arithmetic.
_roll is used in the profit division and subtraction arithmetic.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable under onlyOwner.
newMinimumBet is written into minBet state variable.
newStatus is written into the gamePaused state variable.
ZethrMainBankrollAddress is used to fetch the bankroll list in setupBankrollInterface.
_from is copied into _tkn.sender inside execute.
_value is copied into _tkn.value inside execute.
_data is indexed to derive chosenNumber in execute.
divRate selects the contractBalance/maxProfit slot in setMaxProfit.
newBalance overwrites contractBalance[divRate] in bankrollExternalUpdateTokens.
blockn parameter is fed to blockhash in maxRandom.
entropy address is packed into the randomness keccak256 in maxRandom.
playerRoll memory struct carries state through _finishBet logic.
result local determines win/lose branch in _finishBet.
profit local is passed to RequestBankrollPayment in _finishBet.
tier local indexes UsedBankrollAddresses in RequestBankrollPayment.
tokenBankrollAddress local is the target of the external gameRequestTokens call.
Constructor calls setupBankrollInterface.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll calls WithdrawToBankroll after Zethr.withdraw.
RequestBankrollPayment calls ZethrTierLibrary.getTier to resolve the tier.
finishBet delegates settlement to _finishBet.
execute calls _playerRollDice after decoding the roll.
_playerRollDice calls _finishBet to settle a previous unfinished roll.
_finishBet calls random for the roll result.
_finishBet calls calculateProfit whose unchecked mul/div can overflow.
_finishBet reads getMaxProfit to clamp the payout.
_finishBet calls subContractBalance which mutates contractBalance via arithmetic.
_finishBet calls addContractBalance which mutates contractBalance via arithmetic.
_finishBet calls setMaxProfit after settling the bet.
random calls maxRandom.
setupBankrollInterface calls gameGetTokenBankrollList on the main bankroll.
RequestBankrollPayment performs an external call to gameRequestTokens before finishing; external callee could re-enter.
WithdrawToBankroll executes the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll performs external Zethr.withdraw call.
ownerkill executes the selfdestruct unsafe operation.
_playerRollDice writes the playerRoll struct into playerRolls storage.
_finishBet reads and clears playerRolls[target].
setMaxProfit reads contractBalance[divRate].
setMaxProfit writes maxProfit[divRate].
_finishBet indirectly updates contractBalance through add/sub helpers.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens writes contractBalance[divRate].
ownerUpdateContractBalance writes contractBalance[divRate].
setupBankrollInterface assigns UsedBankrollAddresses from the main bankroll.
setupBankrollInterface fills the ValidBankrollAddress whitelist mapping.
WithdrawToBankroll reads UsedBankrollAddresses[0] as transfer target.
RequestBankrollPayment reads UsedBankrollAddresses[tier] as the call target.
The token bankroll external call can re-enter execute/finishBet before state is finalized.
RequestBankrollPayment resolves the tier bankroll interface gameRequestTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: _rollUnder only carries the chosen roll value into _playerRollDice.
_tkn is a transient carrier of sender/value for _playerRollDice.
userDivRate is only consumed by the _playerRollDice tier selection.
target is only used as the playerRolls index inside _finishBet.
to is immediately forwarded to the external gameRequestTokens call.
tokens is immediately forwarded to the external gameRequestTokens call.
_initBet is only used inside the calculateProfit arithmetic.
_roll is only used inside the calculateProfit arithmetic.
newOwner is solely written to the owner state variable.
newMinimumBet is solely written to the minBet state variable.
newStatus is solely written to the gamePaused state variable.
The address is only used to fetch the bankroll list during setup.
_from is only copied into _tkn.sender inside execute.
_value is only copied into _tkn.value inside execute.
_data is only decoded into chosenNumber inside execute.
divRate only selects the storage slot processed by setMaxProfit and its helpers.
newBalance is only written into contractBalance[divRate].
blockn is only passed to blockhash inside maxRandom.
entropy is only packed into the randomness hash inside maxRandom.
The playerRoll memory copy exists only during _finishBet execution.
result is a temporary derived from random() inside _finishBet.
profit is a temporary computed and spent inside _finishBet.
tier is a temporary computed by getTier inside RequestBankrollPayment.
tokenBankrollAddress is only the target of the external gameRequestTokens unsafe call.
